description: Formatter and lint recipes: ktlint on Compose, Prettier on Expo, dart format on Flutter. Pinned, no network at build time.

justRecipes.name: format
justRecipes.description: Format Kotlin sources with ktlint (pinned in mise.toml)

justRecipes.name: format-check
justRecipes.description: Check Kotlin formatting with ktlint without changing files

notes: Compose: ktlint 1.8.0 via mise; android_studio code style and Composable naming come from the template .editorconfig.
Expo: Prettier 3.10.1 through npx with a pinned version; expo lint stays the linter.
Flutter: dart format and flutter analyze (flutter_lints from the official template).
Upstream licenses: MIT (ktlint, Prettier), BSD-3-Clause (Dart SDK).
